text.text: Tool cards
One card per tool, best Fmax first: what it compares, whether it will work for your proteins, where it is strong and weak, what it costs, and the exact command that was run.
Data from 20 Oct 2026, commit 7eca428b (source)
Filter the cards

Figure 1. Each tool's best Fmax at each of the 15 relatives, one bar per relative from the nearest (chimpanzee, 6 Mya) to the farthest (thale cress (Arabidopsis), 1,516 Mya), then E. coli, which has no TimeTree age: Pfam domains, raw calls, all proteins, best over the tool's settings. Every card uses the same scale, 0 to 0.45. Hover a bar for its relative and number.
phmmer
Amino-acid letters, one query protein against each protein of the relative, scored with a substitution matrix the way BLAST does but with HMMER's model of insertions and deletions.
0.333 best Fmax$0.0186 per 1,000 queriesPfam, raw calls, zebrafish; default options permissive licenceknown failure modes: 3
MMseqs2
Amino-acid letters: it first keeps target proteins that share similar short words with the query, then aligns only those, which makes it much faster than aligning every pair.
0.327 best Fmax$0.00113 per 1,000 queriesPfam, raw calls, zebrafish; sensitivity 7 permissive licenceknown failure modes: 1
MMseqs2, three rounds
A profile of a protein family, built by MMseqs2 from its own hits over three rounds of search, as jackhmmer does.
0.324 best Fmax$0.00351 per 1,000 queriesPfam, raw calls, zebrafish; sensitivity 7, 3 rounds permissive licenceknown failure modes: 3
HH-suite (hhsearch)
Two profiles against each other.
0.313 best Fmax$1.11 per 1,000 queriesPfam, raw calls, zebrafish; single-protein profiles GPL-3.0known failure modes: 1
jackhmmer
A profile of a protein family: it searches with one protein, builds a profile from the hits, and searches again with that profile, three rounds in all.
0.290 best Fmax$0.109 per 1,000 queriesPfam, raw calls, zebrafish; 3 rounds permissive licenceknown failure modes: 2
Foldseek
Predicted 3-D shapes.
0.250 best Fmax$0.00574 per 1,000 queriesPfam, raw calls, zebrafish; shape letters + amino acids needs 3D structure predictionGPL-3.0known failure modes: 2
ProstT5 + Foldseek
Shape letters (3Di) predicted from the amino-acid sequence by the ProstT5 protein language model, then searched with Foldseek, so no AlphaFold model is needed.
0.223 best Fmax$0.00486 per 1,000 queriesPfam, raw calls, zebrafish; shape letters from sequence needs GPUGPL-3.0known failure modes: 1
kmerseek
Short words of k letters (k-mers) shared between two proteins.
0.192 best Fmax$0.00246 per 1,000 queriesPfam, raw calls, zebrafish; gbmr4, k = 21 permissive licenceclaims: 1 holds, 2 disprovedknown failure modes: 2
hmmscan with Pfam
Each query protein against the curated profile models of every Pfam family, without searching any relative.
Searches Pfam's models, not a relative, so it has one number and no bar per relative.
